title: Restore legacy route and interaction baseline
rationale: Ported the archived Senshac Astro surface, localized route tree, Tina boundary, UnoCSS styling, Alpine/HTMX behavior, R2/HLS helpers, SEO endpoints, redirects, and accessibility/performance contracts without copying editorial pages or media into senshac-web.

outcomes.notes: The modular Astro app still preserves the restored localized route, interaction, Tina, media, and SEO source boundaries without moving editorial documents or raw media into senshac-web.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; current localized route and Tina/content contract tests passed.

title: Restore Pages runtime from confirmed archived contract
rationale: The archived production wrangler contract confirms the Pages output directory, nodejs_compat flag, media base URL, MEDIA_RAW R2 bucket, and SESSION KV namespace. The placeholder public index override must stay out of the build so Astro localized routes remain authoritative.

outcomes.notes: Current wrangler.jsonc retains Pages dist output, nodejs_compat, MEDIA_RAW R2, SESSION KV, and media base URL; astro.config.mjs still uses preview.invalid, so production URL and live binding identity remain cutover blockers.
outcomes.test_results: Current wrangler.jsonc, astro.config.mjs, and docs/legacy-parity-audit.md reviewed; no production/deployment verification claimed.

name: canonical chrome presets
description: Site chrome is modeled as chrome.header and chrome.footer with mode, atFinal, and scrolling fields; appearance values are limited to the five canonical presets and runtime defaults preserve legacy page headerStyle until editorial content lands.

outcomes.notes: Current typed content schema and chrome components retain the header/footer appearance presets and runtime defaults.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; page-chrome and Tina-island contract tests passed.

name: chrome foreground follows appearance
description: Header controls and footer content should derive foreground colors from the canonical chrome appearance state; CMS social icon values must resolve through a fixed UnoCSS icon allowlist.

outcomes.notes: Current chrome implementation still derives control/footer foreground from appearance and UnoCSS explicitly imports the icon collections used by the allowlist.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; build and generated icon/admin routing check passed.

name: Tina Astro island route wiring
description: The Tina Astro experimental runtime is restored by exporting experimental_createIslandRoute(createIslands()) from src/pages/tina-island/[name].ts; the package helper preserves preview POST/content-type and same-site boundaries while rendering the existing registry in Cloudflare SSR. Keep a source contract test covering route delegation and all page/global islands.

outcomes.notes: The Tina Astro island route still delegates through experimental_createIslandRoute(createIslands()) and the contract tests retain authenticated preview and registry coverage.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; Tina island route tests passed.

name: Preserve generated Tina admin bundle
description: Keep tinacms generated public/admin assets in the Pages dist package; use explicit Pages redirects for /admin and /es/admin to canonical /admin/. The typecheck wrapper temporarily hides vendor admin assets so Astro diagnostics remain bounded.

outcomes.notes: Current Tina build emits public/admin/index.html, normalization packages the admin assets, and Pages redirects retain canonical admin routes.
outcomes.test_results: npm run build succeeded; node scripts/admin-routing-check.mjs passed.

title: Keep cutover blocked on production URL and runtime evidence
rationale: The old parity audit’s missing Tina admin and root-brand assets have since been repaired. The production URL blocker remains: astro.config.mjs still defaults to https://preview.invalid, the parity audit requires PUBLIC_SITE_URL at promotion, and workspace seed senshac-workspace-c714 remains open for live Cloudflare/R2/KV, accessibility, media, and rollback evidence. Do not promote until an owner supplies and verifies deployment identity and runtime evidence.

outcomes.notes: Updated this decision to current evidence: root icon/admin failures are resolved, but preview.invalid and missing production/runtime/rollback proof remain blockers; workspace acceptance Seed c714 is still open.
outcomes.test_results: Reviewed current source and docs/legacy-parity-audit.md; seeds show senshac-workspace-c714 open with live-cutover acceptance.

name: Live-edit global chrome and fresh island queries
description: Wrap Base layout header and footer fallbacks in TinaIsland markers using locale params, keep the page island as the sole primary form, and avoid process-wide request caching so deployed preview updates can fetch fresh Tina data.

outcomes.notes: Re-audited current live-edit contract and Tina request behavior.
outcomes.test_results: node --test test/tina-island-route.test.mjs test/legacy-parity.test.mjs test/page-chrome.test.mjs: 12 passed, 0 failed.

title: Freeze legacy block parity contract
rationale: Compared senshac-web against archived senshac b46b933: all 19 legacy block templates and 27 metadata marker signatures are already present. Added a focused regression test so future schema or renderer changes expose parity loss.

outcomes.notes: Current regression suite confirms legacy template and metadata-marker parity.
outcomes.test_results: node --test test/legacy-parity.test.mjs: passed; included in 12-test targeted suite.

name: Web quality parity gate
description: The legacy quality parity port is committed as deterministic Bun scripts and budgets; the full bun run quality gate passes after Tina generation, while Astro/Tina deprecation and prerender warnings remain visible as build output for follow-up.

outcomes.notes: Current full web quality gate passes.
outcomes.test_results: bun run quality: exit code 0; repository check passed.

name: Legal smoke uses rendered article landmark
description: The localized legal-notice and privacy-policy routes render MDX content in an article rather than a main element; browser smoke coverage should assert that article exists and has non-empty text while retaining main checks for the other representative routes.

name: Keep Tina local generation on its declared toolchain
description: Keep Tina CLI's Vite 6 dependency tree isolated under tools/tina while Astro uses root Vite 8 with Vite/esbuild overrides required for the Cloudflare Pages worker output; this avoids Tina's generated duplicate GraphQL filter scan errors without changing the app toolchain. Tina config localContentPath resolves from tina/, so pass a sibling senshac-content checkout as ../../senshac-content/main relative to the web root. Local indexing proves schema generation only; live collection visibility and edit-to-PR behavior still need TinaCloud/GitHub owner access.

name: Tina admin toolchain verification
description: Keep the committed Tina package/lock versions as the supported generation set; when changing Tina or S3 media dependencies, rebuild the admin bundle and run the admin-routing contract because stale or incompatible bundling can reintroduce browser-external Node stubs.

outcomes.notes: Current Tina version set, generation wrapper, and admin-routing gate match this updated dependency guidance.
outcomes.test_results: npm run build succeeded; node scripts/admin-routing-check.mjs passed; npm test 43/43.

name: Tina admin bundle normalization and icons
description: Normalize generated Tina admin assets before Pages packaging and explicitly include required Iconify collections in UnoCSS; the admin-routing check verifies the canonical entry and generated icon CSS.

outcomes.notes: The build runs Tina asset normalization, and UnoCSS includes the explicit required icon sets.
outcomes.test_results: npm run build succeeded; admin-routing check passed (canonical admin route and generated icon CSS).
